name: Red Avenue New Materials Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Red Avenue New Materials Group Co., Ltd. makes materials for the tire, electronics and biodegradable materials industries through three segments. The rubber additives and chemicals segment produces phenolic resins, processing aids, anti-reversion agents and coupling agents for tires. The electronic materials segment makes photoresists, high-purity solvents and polishing pads, and the biodegradable segment makes PBAT products for packaging and agricultural mulch films.
